tx:
▸ Steps
To create the Rod of Ivandis: 
• Use soft clay on the Ivandis' tomb to make the mould. The tomb can be found in the Meiyerditch tunnels, which is in the first cave entrance from the north beyond the wall on the east.
• Put a sapphire in the backpack, a mithril bar, and a silver bar in either the metal bank or the backpack, and craft them together in a furnace. The resulting item will be a silvthril rod.
• Enchant the rod with the Lvl-1 Enchant spell or tablet.
• Use the rod on the well within Paterdomus with a rope in the backpack.
